narrative: The author remains bullish on energy and sees potential for a broader commodity cycle as gold and oil begin to move together. Supply disruption and persistent inflation dominate the macro framing. Beneath the broad market, weakening consumer and financial-sector breadth raises concern. Explicit actions include Brazil exposure, an offshore driller holding, a chemical-company purchase and a financial-sector inverse fund. A late nuclear-stock purchase shows willingness to take selected technical opportunities despite broad caution. The author repeatedly emphasizes timing and the possibility of false support breaks.
